newsitem.title: USA: Texaco reaches tentative settlement in lawsuit - CNN.
newsitem.headline: Texaco reaches tentative settlement in lawsuit - CNN.

text.p: Texaco Inc has reached a tentative agreement to settle a racial discrimination suit, CNN reported Friday.
The company could not immediately confirm the report.
CNN said that, in a conference call on Friday, the judge handling the case had given the nod to the company and the plaintiffs to draft a final settlement.
Texaco was under pressure to reach a settlement before Saturday, when civil rights leaders intended to press for a boycott of Texaco products and start picketing Texaco service stations nationwide.
African American employees filed the lawsuit against Texaco in 1994 seeking payments of $71 million.

The case hit the news last week after transcripts -- later proved partly incorrect -- from a company meeting showed Texaco officials proposing to destroy documents called for in the case and using racial slurs to describe minority employees.
